title: Peruvian Beef Stew
description: A hearty, keto-friendly beef stew with a Peruvian twist, featuring tender beef and sweet beetroot.

ingredients.name: Peruvian stew spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Latin American markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, in batches if necessary, until browned and cooked to your liking. Set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the diced onion, sautéing until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced beetroot, Peruvian stew spice mix, and tomato paste to the pot. Stir to combine.
Pour in the beef broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the browned beef to the pot and cook for an additional 30 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
